_comment: Copy to config/phone-input.local.json (gitignored) for tools/phone-input/phone-input.mjs. chatId = the group that only the owner and the bot are in; ownerOpenId = the owner's open_id (only their text messages are pasted). keyFile holds the shared loopback key (>= 32 chars, chmod 600) — the Windows client keeps a copy of the same key. Everything below chatId/ownerOpenId is optional; the values shown are the defaults. reactions: chat emoji_type put on a message once the Windows side acked it (pasted / not pasted); an empty string turns that reaction off.
